title: Warm Molten Filipino Passata Halo Halo
description: A diabetic-friendly Filipino dessert featuring passata, served warm and molten, perfect for a weeknight treat.
instructions: Preheat the sous-vide machine to 160 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine passata, coconut milk, sweetened condensed milk, and sugar-free vanilla extract, if using.
Stir well to combine and pour the mixture into small ramekins or cups.
Place the ramekins in the sous-vide machine and cook for 30 minutes.
While the passata mixture is cooking, prepare the toppings by draining the jackfruit and kaong and slicing them into bite-sized pieces.
To assemble the halo halo, place a few pieces of jackfruit and kaong at the bottom of a glass or bowl.
Remove the passata mixture from the sous-vide machine and pour it over the fruit.
Top with toasted pinipig and serve immediately.
Repeat the assembly process for the remaining servings.
